verified_good_products.title: Prefabricated Guest House
verified_good_products.description:
GI Portable Cabins are modular structures constructed using galvanized iron (GI) sheets. These cabins are known for their durability, resistance to weather conditions, and quick assembly. They are commonly used for various purposes, including site offices, temporary housing, security cabins, and more. Here's a detailed overview of GI portable cabins:

Features of GI Portable Cabins

  1. Construction Materials:

    • Galvanized Iron (GI) Sheets: GI sheets are used for the walls, roof, and sometimes the flooring of the cabin. The galvanization process involves coating the iron with zinc to prevent rust and corrosion.
    • Structural Framework: Typically includes steel or aluminum frames to support the GI sheets and provide additional stability.
    • Insulation: Depending on the design, insulation materials may be added to improve thermal comfort and energy efficiency.

  2. Design Elements:

    • Interior Layout: Can be customized based on needs, including office spaces, storage areas, or living quarters. Common features include desks, chairs, shelving, and basic furnishings.
    • Windows and Doors: Equipped with windows and doors made of durable materials, often with security features. Windows may be fitted with screens or bars, and doors are usually lockable.
    • Ventilation and Climate Control: Includes ventilation systems to ensure airflow. Some models may have air conditioning or heating options to maintain a comfortable
